name: Izu (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Izu city emblem in white: an outlined stylised device of a curved stroke and a loop, like a letter B.
history: Municipal flag of Izu, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 June 2004.

features.role: Izu city emblem — an outlined stylised device of a curved stroke and a loop, like a letter B
